summary: Chelan County drive-up summit near Leavenworth; a 40-foot L-4 tower built 1937 and removed 1967; undated WillhiteWeb photo captions show a cell tower and parking on the summit.

facts.status_note: Tower removed in 1967; undated WillhiteWeb photo captions show a cell tower on the summit

staffing.status: Named lookouts 1957 to 1965; no staffing after the tower was removed is described

access.note: Drive-up on gravel and dirt roads; most passenger cars can get within a quarter mile of the summit. No closure or permit rule in the sources read.

visit.trail_note: No tower stands. WillhiteWeb says walking FR 400 from the four-way at Boundary Pass is around 2 miles with a 600 foot gain.

events.note: Forest Lookouts lists panorama photos taken September 14, 1934, earlier than the 1937 build year in the other sources
Built in 1937 as a 40-foot pole L-4 tower
Tower removed in 1967 (all four sources that give a year)

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The Forest Lookouts page dates panorama photos to September 14, 1934, but the register, Firelookout.com and WillhiteWeb all give 1937 as the build year. The story uses 1937 and notes the earlier photo date. None of the sources explains it.

notes_for_editor: Brief lists access as unknown; the sources describe a drive-up summit and none names a closure, so the record is set to public. The only present-day feature described is a cell tower and parking (WillhiteWeb, undated page). The 1934 panorama date predates the 1937 build year and is unexplained.
